blocks.text: Experience day-long comfort and productivity with this wireless ergonomic keyboard and mouse combo. Typing feels instantly familiar on Wave Keys’ wavy keyframe design. The cushioned keyboard palm rest lifts pressure and improves wrist support. The Signature M550 L Wireless Mouse features a contoured shape and rubber side grip to keep medium- to large-sized hands comfortable throughout the day. This wireless keyboard and mouse combo is made with recycled plastic (10) and connect easily using Bluetooth or the included Logi Bolt receiver. The ergonomic keyboard has up to 3 years of battery life, while the mouse has up to 2 years of battery life using the included batteries (3).

items.label: Meet the comfort combo
items.value: Get comfier with the Wave Keys Ergonomic Wireless Keyboard paired with the Signature M550 L Wireless Mouse - a great fit for medium- to large-sized hands

items.label: Compact keys
items.value: Wave Keys’ compact size allows you to bring your mouse closer to your body, resulting in a more natural shoulder position compared to a full size keyboard

items.label: Type in comfort all day long
items.value: The wavy design of this compact keyboard places your hands, wrists and forearms in a natural typing position for all-day comfort

items.label: More palm support, less pressure
items.value: A cushioned palm rest with memory foam gives you more wrist support throughout the day (1)

items.label: Less noise, more focus
items.value: On top of its sculpted design and rubber grip, this quiet mouse uses SilentTouch technology to make workdays more peaceful with 90% less click noise (7)

items.label: Scroll smarter
items.value: Scroll through documents line by line, or fly effortlessly through long web pages with SmartWheel

items.label: Smoother days, your Way
items.value: Personalize your Wave Keys experience using the Logi Options+ App, where you can choose shortcuts that save time and keep your work flowing (2)

items: Connect the keyboard via Bluetooth or Logi Bolt and use Easy-Switch* to toggle between PC, tablet, and phone (Windows/macOS/iPadOS/ChromeOS); *not-applicable for Signature M550 L mouse
Plastic parts in Wave Keys and Signature M550 L include certified post-consumer recycled plastic (Keyboard: 61%(5), Mouse: 65%(6))
In case of wireless keyboard or combo (keyboard and mouse), the USB receiver is usually provided either inside the mouse (under the battery cover) or attached within the product packaging
